evidence.title: Beyond chlorophyll: machine learning estimates of diagnostic phytoplankton pigments from multispectral ocean colour data

summary: Researchers have created a machine‑learning system that estimates concentrations of multiple diagnostic phytoplankton pigments—beyond just chlorophyll—using satellite multispectral ocean‑colour observations. The approach promises finer‑grained monitoring of marine ecosystems and carbon cycles.
title: AI model predicts detailed phytoplankton pigment composition from multispectral ocean‑colour data
